root_idea.summary: A semantic orientation toward dustiness or grayness together with fineness and lightness.
root_idea.development: This orientation appears in fine airborne dust and motes, dust rising or spreading, and the related description of ashes or embers mixing with dust and going out.

qac_form_accounting.reason: A Quran-attested nominal form with a clear classical citation form.

senses.definition: Fine dust or minute motes dispersed in the air.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, used in constructions describing dust scattered or spread abroad, including هَبَاءً مَنْثُورًا and هَبَاءً مُنْبَثًّا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of ashes, and also embers: to become mixed with dust and be extinguished.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I verb describing the resulting condition of ashes or embers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dust rising or spreading in the sky like smoke.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for a visible spread or cloud of dust.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The ashes/embers becoming mixed with dust and going out are represented.
Dust rising or spreading like smoke is represented.
Fine motes visible in sunbeams are covered by the Quranic fine-dust sense.
